title: YorvoGate version, format 1
description: What `yorvogate version --json` prints: the build's version and the Docker API versions it serves (docs/configuration.md#formats-and-versions). Open for additions at every level (ADR-0005, amendment 1).

version.description: The release's version (0.4.0), or dev for a build that isn't one.

api.description: The Docker API versions this build serves: a client negotiates within them, whatever Docker's own are.
